parent_objective: audit corrected public pilot results before any repeat, longer run, promotion, or paper-level claim
blocked_by: M1209 produced corrected public pilot trends but L2/current-tiled and L3/reset-control implications are not yet audited
supersedes: directly scaling corrected pilot results without audit
invalidates: claiming finite-window history necessity or recurrent hidden benefit directly from M1209 aggregates

public_gates: M1210 may audit M1209 artifacts only
M1210 must classify L2 normal-vs-current-tiled results
M1210 must classify L3 online-vs-corrected-reset results
M1210 must check runner/eval validity before interpreting results
M1210 must not use private holdout
M1210 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles based on M1209
do not convert public pilot trends into paper-level claims
do not claim recurrent belief or self-identification without causal history gates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies whether M1209 supports longer repeat, architecture repair, or stronger history-necessity tests
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1209 artifacts are incomplete
stop if eval semantics did not apply corrected controls
stop if result interpretation requires private holdout
fallback_plan: route to runner/eval repair if artifacts are invalid
route to corrected pilot repeat if trends are promising but seed-fragile
route to architecture/profile repair if controls explain the apparent temporal advantage
route to branch synthesis if the result changes the paper route
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1209 produced corrected public pilot results that need interpretation before any next training

admission_evidence: M1209 completed all 24 public pilot seed runs
M1209 recorded profile_seed_rows eval_rows profile_aggregate and summary artifacts
M1209 kept private holdout promotion per-profile tuning actor-input changes and self-ID claims disabled
blocked_shortcuts: do not make performance promotion paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: next repeat repair or synthesis milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1210 must decide whether M1209 L2 results still show current-frame substitution risk.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1209 remains public pilot trend evidence; M1210 cannot upgrade it to causal history proof.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record L2/current-tiled parity or L3/reset parity as negative evidence and route to repair or stronger tests instead of weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1209 corrected public pilot artifacts can be audited to decide whether to repeat, scale, repair, or synthesize the profile-comparison branch.
success_criteria: M1209 summary and aggregate are checked
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next repeat, repair, or synthesis milestone is selected
failure_criteria: metrics are framed as paper-level evidence
self-identification is claimed from public pilot aggregates
failed or negative trends are omitted

commands.name: audit_corrected_profile_pilot
commands.command: audit M1209 corrected public pilot artifacts without training

decision_rule: M1210 passes if M1209 is audited without claim expansion and routes to a specific repeat, repair, or synthesis milestone.
